content.text: Problem: Determine the local solar time (LST) and declination at a location latitude 23° 15'N, longitude 77° 30' E at 12.30 IST on June 19. Equation of time correction = – (1'01") from standard table.
Solution: LST = IST – (Standard time longitude – Longitude of location) + Equation of time correction
Declination from Cooper's equation: δ(in degree) = 23.45 sin{(360/365)(284 + n)}
Where n = days of the year. For June 19: n = 31+28+31+30+31+19 = 170 days

content.text: Problem: Calculate the angle made by beam radiation with the normal to a flat plate collector on December 1, at 9.00 am, solar time for a location at 28°35'N. The collector is tilted to an angle of latitude plus 10° with the horizontal and is pointing due south.
Solution: cos θ_T = cos(φ – s) cos δ cos w + sin(φ + s) sin δ
Declination from Cooper equation on December 1, n = 335:
Hour angle w corresponding to 9.00 am = 45°
cos θ_T = cos10° cos22.11° cos45° + sin22.11° sin10° = 0.71 ∴ θ_T = 44.72°

content.text: Problem: Wind at atmospheric pressure and 15°C has velocity of 15 m/s. Turbine diameter = 120 m, operating speed = 40 r.p.m. Calculate: (a) Total power density, (b) Maximum obtainable power density, (c) Reasonable power density (η=35%), (d) Total power, (e) Torque and axial thrust.
Solution: Air density δ = P/RT = (1.01325 × 10⁵)/(287 × 288) = 1.226 Kg/m³

(a) Power density = (1/2gc) ρv₁³ = ½ × 1.226 × 15³ ≅ 2069 W/m² (b) Max power density = (8/27gc) ρAv₁³ ≅ 1226 W/m² (c) P/A = η × 2069 = 0.35 × 2069 = 724 W/m² (d) Total power = 724 × (π/4) × (120)² = 8184 kW (e) Torque at max efficiency ≅ 55170 Newton Max axial thrust ≅ 14 × 10⁵ Newton

content.text: Problem: Bio-gas digester for 5 cows. Retention time: 20 days, Temperature: 30°C, Dry matter consumed/day: 2 kg, Bio-gas yield: 0.24 m³/kg, Burner efficiency: 60%, CH₄ proportion: 0.8, Heat of combustion of CH₄: 28 MJ/m³, Density of slurry: 50 kg/m³.
Solution:

Mass of dry input: m₀ = 2 kg/day × 5 = 10 kg/day Fluid volume: V_f = m₀/ρ_m = 10/50 = 0.2 m³/day Digester volume: V_d = 0.2 × 20 = 4.0 m³ (Ans i) Volume of biogas: V_b = 0.24 × 10 = 2.4 m³/day Power = η × H_m × F_m × V_b = 0.6 × 28 × 0.8 × 2.4 = 32.25 MJ/day = 8.8 kWh/day = 370 W (Ans ii)

content.text: Problem: A tidal power plant of simple single basin type, has a basin area = 30 × 10⁶ m². The tide has a range of 12 m. Turbine stops operating when the head falls below 3 m. Calculate the energy generated in one filling/emptying process, if generating efficiency of turbine is 0.73.
Solution: The total theoretical work:
W = ½gρA(R² – r²) P_av = W/time = gρA(R² – r²)/44,700 = (1/44,700) × 9.8 × 1025 × 30×10⁶ (12² – 3²) watts = 3280.5 × 10⁶ kWh Energy generated = 3280.5 × 10⁶ × 0.73 = 2395 × 10⁶ kWh
